subject: The docked Mixer's layout area: the description it carries, and whether the product locates it by that description
question: On a ko-KR Logic, what description does the docked Mixer's layout area carry, and does the product locate that area to read the insert slots in it?

reverify.expected: exits 0 with every check PASS on a ko-KR Logic; the evidence's probe rows carry the strings quoted in observations
reverify.cost: ~3 min per locale after `swift build -c release --product LogicProMCP`; needs Logic relaunched in ko-KR (`defaults write com.apple.logic10 AppleLanguages -array ko`) on a disposable project whose first track holds a Compressor on insert 0, the Mixer docked, no editor open, and nobody using the Mac

canon.used_for: the row AXLocalePolicy.mixerNamedElement derives from, matched after normalizing against the Mixer layout area's description

method: Release build of the working tree whose Sources/ tree is 50c52b8df05f (binary sha256 4ec371bf65f8...), copied out of .build and run from the copy; control: release build of ec388223, the head of pull request 976, which carries these locators as they stood before this change (binary sha256 ad33286f77b7...). Driven by Scripts/livekit/live_977_locale_locators.py, added in this change, after `defaults write com.apple.logic10 AppleLanguages -array ko` and a relaunch on a disposable project whose first track holds a Compressor on insert 0 and whose Mixer is docked. Scripts/livekit/ax_977_locator_probe.swift reads the tree STRUCTURALLY -- a Mixer area is a container holding AXLayoutItem children, an occupied slot is an AXGroup whose direct children are [AXCheckBox, AXButton, AXButton], an editor is an AXDialog -- so a label the product gets wrong cannot hide the element. The product was then driven through the paths the locators gate: logic_plugins get_inventory on track 0, logic_project save with the editor the probe opened (by pressing the first occupied slot's first AXButton), and logic_plugins set_param_verified on the Compressor's threshold (normalized, duplicate_applyback), each by both builds in the same run. The Compressor was addressed by plugin id logic.stock.effect.compressor, never by its localized name. Before this run the same readings were taken in all ten locales by an uncommitted predecessor of the harness, which differed only in finding the Compressor by name; they agreed with these.

observations.what: containers holding channel strips whose description matches this locale's Mixer#acc row, ignoring case as the product does

conclusion: On a ko-KR Logic the docked Mixer is an AXLayoutArea whose description is '믹서', the value Apple ships at Logic.framework's Mixer#acc row; the Inspector's strips sit in a second area with the same description. The fixed build located the Mixer and read the inserts in State A. So did the control build.
limits: One host: Logic 12.3 (6674) on macOS 26.3 (25D125), one disposable project, one Compressor. Other builds are not measured here.

The control is the pre-change build of the same code line, not a release; a failure it shows is attributed to the locators because the new build differs from it in Sources/ only by this change, and that attribution is an inference from the diff rather than something the run isolates.
Only locating the area is measured. No mixer.* operation beyond get_inventory and the plug-in write that depends on it is claimed for this locale.
The Inspector's area carries the same description; that the product does not pick it is shown only by get_inventory reading the docked Mixer's inserts, not by a separate reading.
